checked_unchanged: The Census Bureau's 120th Congress page (https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/decennial-census/about/rdo/congressional-districts.html) says only AL, CA, FL, LA, MO, NC, OH, TN, TX and UT submitted new lines and every other state kept its 2024 districts; I cross-checked this against the Loyola 'All About Redistricting' state data (updated 2026-09-10) and Wikipedia's 2025-2026 redistricting pages. Those sources also confirm that Missouri's 2025 HB 1 map was suspended for 2026 (state supreme court 2026-09-03, U.S. Supreme Court stay 2026-09-10), so Missouri uses its 2022 map even though Census products carry the 2025 plan. They also confirm that the Virginia referendum map was struck (2026-05-08), New York's NY-11 redraw was blocked (2026-03-02), Georgia keeps its 2023 map (used in 2024) through November 2026, and Maryland, Indiana, Kansas, South Carolina and Wisconsin did not change their maps.
